articles.body: On Tuesday, September 22, Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met in New York to discuss the war in Ukraine. Ahead of Zelensky’s address to the UN General Assembly today, he said he wants the war to end before winter, stressing that people across Ukraine are living in increasingly difficult conditions and that the longer the conflict continues, the greater the risk of further deaths on the frontline. Trump has also said that Ukraine and Russia agreed not to target each other’s energy infrastructure, after previously criticising Kyiv for striking Russian oil refineries. According to France 24 correspondent from Ukraine, Gulliver Cragg, Another potential area for a temporary ceasefire could be the Black Sea, where attacks have disrupted Ukrainian and Russian grain shipments. Ukraine has indicated it is willing to cooperate, although Zelensky has questioned whether Russia would do the same. Analysts say the growing Ukrainian pressure on Russian oil infrastructure could create an opening for a limited ceasefire, although there is uncertainty over how strongly Trump is pushing for such an agreement and when he would want it to happen. France 24 International Affairs editor Philip Turle shares further details.
articles.headline: Trump and Zelensky discuss path to ending Ukraine war

articles.body: Sen. Jon Husted became the latest battleground Republican this week to call for a quick end to the Iran war, as panic grows over how high gas prices and President Donald Trump’s agenda could imperil the party’s chances in November. “The war needs to come to an end as quickly as possible so that we can lower gas prices,” the Ohio senator told POLITICO, in his furthest comments yet on the matter. Coming after Iowa Senate nominee Ashley Hinson, who broke from Trump over the war on Monday , and Michigan Senate nominee Mike Rogers , who followed suit hours later, Husted’s comments are another example of the pressure he and other Republicans are under to address prices at the pump. Several candidates are creating some distance from Trump, as voters continue to blame the president for the current economy and the Iran conflict for high costs of living. Husted said in the interview that he still thinks Iran needs to reach a deal with Trump to end the conflict, but added: “I don’t know anybody that doesn’t want the war to come to an end.” He has a finer line to walk with Trump in his state, and Republicans close to him say he can’t and won't completely break with the president. Husted does not plan to support the Democratic-led war powers resolution when it comes up for a vote in the Senate this week, a spokesperson said. And Trump and Vice President JD Vance are expected to visit the state in the coming weeks to shore up his campaign and drive GOP turnout. Husted is staring down a tight race against former Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown, where millions in spending and recent polling have put Brown slightly ahead. Top Hill Republicans and Senate GOP operatives have said the Ohio Senate race is among their primary concerns in the battle to keep control of the chamber. But Ohio is just one in a series of battlegrounds where rising gas prices have become a defining issue. Beyond Hinson and Rogers, a growing number of Republicans are starting to call for emergency actions like a diesel export ban to lower gas prices, including Iowa GOP Reps. Zach Nunn and Mariannette Miller-Meeks. “Hinson broke the dam,” said one GOP operative, who was granted anonymity to discuss private conversations. Sen. Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska), who is locked in an incredibly competitive race, called Tuesday for a diesel export ban to provide voters relief. He didn’t mention the Iran war. The panic is being felt most acutely in the Midwest, as high gas and diesel prices and Trump’s tariffs hammer families, truckers and farmers just a few weeks ahead of the peak harvest season with no relief in sight. By Sunday night, Rogers had filmed an ad at a grocery store decrying high prices and, straight to camera, breaking with Trump to call for an end to the Iran war, according to two Republicans involved in the matter, granted anonymity to discuss internal conversations. Rogers’ team was putting the finishing touches on the ad Monday morning when Hinson posted her break with Trump over the war directly on social media. “The war’s just gone on too long. Mike still thinks Iran shouldn’t have a nuclear weapon, but we originally thought this would take six weeks,” said one person with direct knowledge of the conversations in Rogers’ camp about the move. “Voters have been paying for it at their kitchen tables for too long.” Michigan’s GOP nominee for governor, Rep. John James, also said Tuesday the Iran war needs to end “quickly.” And Rep. Tom Tiffany, Wisconsin’s GOP governor nominee, said Tuesday he believes “we should be exiting Iran, that it’s time to move on, we’ve degraded their nuclear facilities, we’ve degraded their military … time to come home, take care of business here in America.” Trump, for his part, told reporters Tuesday that he asked his team to consider a diesel export ban, and that his administration is mulling it. But the move is rife with internal GOP fighting behind the scenes: Trump’s team is getting an earful from GOP lawmakers in oil states who oppose the move, according to four people with direct knowledge of the matter who were granted anonymity to discuss private conversations. That makes any decision before the midterms highly problematic with at least one corner of the party. Both the top House GOP leaders — Speaker Mike Johnson and Majority Leader Steve Scalise — have opposed similar measures from the past to protect their oil state of Louisiana. The Texas GOP delegation is also “strongly opposed,” according to another Republican. Husted told POLITICO on Tuesday that he supports his state legislature suspending Ohio’s gas tax for a period. Democrat Amy Acton, who is running for governor, called for a gas tax suspension Monday . Her GOP opponent Vivek Ramaswamy and a broader swath of Republicans called for the state legislature to convene and pass legislation to suspend the state’s gas tax hours later. “I think in the long run we are going to have lower gas prices,” Husted said, citing the war in Ukraine as a factor for spiking diesel costs as well as the war with Iran. “It's taking longer than any of us wish it would. So in the interim, while those things are concluding, the idea of providing relief from the gas tax for Ohioans for a short period of time is a reasonable thing for Governor [Mike] DeWine to consider.”
articles.headline: Sen. Jon Husted: Iran war ‘needs to come to an end as quickly as possible’

articles.body: LOCAL INPUT: Mayor Zohran Mamdani is facing fresh backlash over sidelining key stakeholders from talks about developing thousands of housing units on top of a Queens rail yard. The Sunnyside Yard project landed back in the headlines yesterday when Mamdani and President Donald Trump emerged from a chummy meeting at Gracie Mansion to announce they’d agreed to bring conversations about the long-stalled housing plan to “a new level.” The unlikely duo first announced at a White House meeting in February they were looking into reviving the project, which would be contingent on billions of dollars in federal funding and involve constructing a platform over the rail yard, on top of which 12,000 housing units would be built. But Council member Julie Won — who represents Sunnyside and voiced concerns in February about not being included in the talks — said today she continues to be troubled by the fact that the mayor and the president aren’t consulting her or other local community voices. “Since the last discussion on Sunnyside Yard months ago between the mayor and president there is no funding from Congress nor any public meetings to move this project forward,” Won said in a statement. “There is no federal, state, or city bill allocating funding for this project. There is still no timeline. Congress would have to fund it, and the State and City Legislature would have to approve it. Our neighbors in Sunnyside yet again were not part of yesterday's conversation, and there still has been no meaningful engagement with the public.” Farah Salam, Won’s chief of staff, said City Hall’s continued lack of engagement with her office flies in the face of a commitment Mamdani’s team made in February. Salam recounted how, in a meeting with Won’s team at the time, Mamdani aides told the Council member’s staff they would keep them in the loop on any Sunnyside Yard-related updates. Nonetheless, Salam told Playbook that Won and her team haven’t heard a peep from Mamdani’s administration since then, and she added that Won only learned of the latest twist from watching Mamdani’s post-meeting press conference with Trump yesterday. A Mamdani spokesperson declined to respond to Salam’s comments. Won is a member of the Council’s Progressive Caucus, which has generally been supportive of the mayor, lending more weight to her Sunnyside-related rebuke. Still, she may have some political sour grapes with the mayor, given that she campaigned unsuccessfully this summer for Congress in a race that was ultimately won by Mamdani-endorsed Assemblymember Claire Valdez. Won isn’t the only local politician concerned by Mamdani’s Sunnyside dealings with Trump, though. Queens Borough President Donovan Richards told Playbook it would be more fruitful for Mamdani to focus on securing federal funding from Trump for housing developments where shovels can hit the ground on a short timeframe. Inevitably, Sunnyside Yard would need to go through years-long review and permitting processes before construction could begin, and Richards argued Jamaica and Long Island City are better suited for immediate, federally-backed projects, given that both areas recently underwent neighborhood-wide rezonings. “I’m not saying give up on Sunnyside Yard, but let’s first move somewhere where we can actually get shovels in the ground now,” he said. “We are in a housing emergency.” Richards also said he’s skeptical Trump will actually make good on his Sunnyside musings. “I have trepidations about how fast the Trump administration is going to move on this — forgive me if I have my trepidations about them,” he said. “Anything you deal with the Trump administration on has to be show and tell, and I don’t have much confidence even with the president's remarks yesterday.” When asked about the comments from Won and Richards at a press conference today, Mamdani avoided any direct response. Instead he simply reiterated the merits of the project, which he said would include a significant share of affordable housing. “I will do everything in my power to build more housing in this city,” Mamdani said. “And working with the president to fulfill an idea that has existed for 50 to 60 years — that to me is clearly an example of what could be done.” It remains to be seen how much Trump and Mamdani can actually get done on the Sunnyside project. Though they said yesterday their respective housing policy teams are initiating technical talks about the project, there are no funding commitments on the table, and local community concerns remain. Former Mayor Bill de Blasio announced a plan in 2015 to build housing on top of Sunnyside Yard, but that iteration of the project never went anywhere because of the COVID pandemic and local pushback. — Chris Sommerfeldt and Joe Anuta  From the Capitol IT GUY GONE: The top official at the state’s Office of Information Technology Services was removed this week by Gov. Kathy Hochul after she lost confidence in him, her administration said today. ITS Director Dru Rai held the job since September 2023, and his removal was effective immediately. Jenson Jacob will take over the role in an acting capacity. The office manages the state's information technology, data centers and hardware infrastructure while providing digital services for state agencies and local governments. “The administration has informed Dru Rai that the Governor no longer has confidence in his ability to effectively represent this administration and he was removed from his position as head of ITS," a Hochul spokesperson said in a statement. "Jenson Jacob has been named Acting Director of ITS. Governor Hochul remains committed to holding employees to the highest leadership and ethical standards, and ITS will continue to deliver technology solutions and services for New Yorkers, our agencies and partners.” Read more from POLITICO Pro’s Nick Reisman. BLAKEMAN BRUSHES OFF GRACIE GATHERING: Republican gubernatorial candidate Bruce Blakeman is downplaying the significance of Trump’s cordial Monday meeting with the mayor. “Not at all,” he said when asked if Trump’s visit undercut Blakeman’s focus on Mamdani’s radicalism. “The president is a government official. He’s the highest government official in the United States. And the mayor’s a government official, so I expect that the two of them would talk.” Blakeman has attacked the mayor he refers to as “Commie Mamdani” while campaigning in every corner of the state. Would he similarly meet with Mamdani? “Depends what he was serving for lunch,” he said. The Nassau County executive was in Albany today to receive the NYS Correctional Officers and Police Benevolent Association’s endorsement. Prison guards have had an icy relationship with the state in recent years, due to Cuomo-era limits on solitary confinement and Hochul’s strict crackdown on guards who engaged in an illegal strike last year. It’s the first time NYSCOPBA has endorsed a gubernatorial candidate. “Kathy Hochul, I want you to think about that: 95 percent of your employees voted to endorse me, a democratic vote,” Blakeman said. “What does that say about your leadership? You should be embarrassed that 95 percent of your workers didn’t think highly enough of you to endorse you.” — Bill Mahoney FROM CITY HALL LEFT ON READ: City Council members — including the mayor’s allies — laced into Mamdani’s administration today at a Council hearing on the use of influencers in city government communications. The central focus of their displeasure? Team Mamdani declined to send any representatives from the appropriate agencies to testify. The oversight hearing comes on the heels of news that programs run by city agencies paid influencers to promote city policies. The hearing’s stated purpose: to begin to establish guidelines for how city officials communicate with influencers and disclose such communications. Emilia Rowland, the mayor’s director of new media, skipped the hearing, despite being invited to testify. Earlier this month, a working paper from the Columbia University Initiative for Policy Dialogue reported that Rowland oversees a Signal group chat with more than 200 hand-picked influencers. In her place, the mayor’s office sent Tascha Van Auken, commissioner of the mayor’s Office of Mass Engagement, and Shawn(ta) Smith-Cruz, commissioner for the Department of Records and Information Services — neither of whom had much to offer on the administration’s use of influencers. While pressing the two during their testimony, Public Advocate Jumaane Williams expressed disappointment that the communications officials who “should be here are not.” “I don't know that anything was done wrong, but there were questions that were raised by this article that I believe the public should hear answers to, so that they can feel sure that nothing wrong occurred,” Williams said. “The fact that the correct folks aren't here doesn't really help that story.” Williams, a progressive Democrat, found himself in agreement with Council Minority Leader David Carr, the Republican who sponsored legislation that would require explicit disclosures on city-funded or directed influencer communications. Carr pressed Van Auken and Smith-Cruz on specifics about the relationship between City Hall and third-party influencers — such as the number of influencers the administration has worked with, how much has been spent on the social media campaigns, how budgets are determined and how influencers are selected. Van Auken and Smith-Cruz acknowledged they didn’t have fulsome answers to any of Carr’s questions, in stark contrast with the mayor’s characterization of the situation earlier today. “I am confident in the testimony that our administration is providing today, that it will be sufficient in answering the council's questions,” Mamdani told reporters this morning. Taiwan Green, a Queens-based influencer with more than 50,000 followers, testified he was contacted a year ago by then-candidate Mamdani’s social media team. He said he’s never been offered pay for any content about the administration, though, and that he was never directed as to how to message his videos. “I believe it’s my responsibility to sacrifice my time and my resources to educate myself and my followers on the political process,” said Green, who goes by the handle @mrfingaz. “Traditional press may not have the time to ask questions that are related to southeast Queens, but I will use this opportunity to do just that.” Green left abruptly after about 90 seconds of testimony and didn’t take questions from council members. It wasn’t the first time relevant officials from the mayor’s office skipped a Council oversight meeting. Last month, lawmakers slammed Mamdani’s administration for opting out of a hearing on the city’s controversial pied-à-terre tax rollout. At that hearing, Council Members Gale Brewer and Linda Lee read out 11 pages of questions to a row of empty chairs. — Molly Reinmann SO MANY GAVELS: The city’s Conflicts of Interest Board fined Council member Mercedes Narcisse $2,500 for filming a reelection campaign video inside City Hall. In one portion of the video, Narcisse is sitting in the Council chambers at the speaker’s chair, where she strikes a gavel. In another, she sits behind her nameplate in a separate committee room and … also strikes a gavel. Narcisse is then filmed speaking (though not striking a gavel) at an official Council podium. Because these areas of City Hall are off limits to the public, the board found Narcisee was using her government perch for personal gain. In a settlement agreement, the Brooklyn lawmaker said she did not intend to break the rules, but admitted wrongdoing. — Joe Anuta FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL AOC IN BUF: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is planning to hit Buffalo Thursday to meet with Mayor Sean Ryan and host an organizing training aimed at inactive voters. The trip comes amid speculation about whether she’ll run for the White House or Senate in 2028. In comments to The New York Times published on Tuesday, Ocasio-Cortez said she’s thinking about how her identity will factor into the campaign she chooses to mount. “There’s an argument that some make that this is a very unique political window and, oftentimes in politics, you do only get one shot,” she told the Times. “And you don’t — and just in life in general — life doesn’t wait for you to be ready for things. Sometimes life just makes things ready for you.” The Buffalo trip is part of an upstate swing that is also set to include Syracuse and Ithaca, the Times reported last week . Ocasio-Cortez has been leaning into the curiosity surrounding her next political endeavor — but said she’s keeping her focus on the midterms as she stumps across the country boosting candidates. — Madison Fernandez TAKING THE STAGE: Candidates for governor, state attorney general and comptroller will debate next month. Spectrum News NY1 announced Tuesday that Hochul and Blakeman will debate on Oct. 13. Attorney General Letitia James will face off against GOP challenger Saritha Komatireddy on Oct. 8, and Comptroller Tom DiNapoli and Republican Joseph Hernandez will debate on Oct. 1. Each of the debates will air live at 7 p.m. Playbook previously reported that Hochul intended to debate Blakeman, even though she is not required to do so since her campaign declined to participate in the new public campaign finance system. — Madison Fernandez IN OTHER NEWS — ZO + BIBI: Mamdani doubled down on his criticism of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of his speech at the U.N. this week. articles.body: CHICAGO — Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker revealed Monday that he was diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes two years ago and began taking a GLP-1 medication, resulting in an 80-pound weight loss that he says has transformed his health and daily life. The disclosure marks the first time the Democrat has publicly disclosed that he has diabetes, as well as officially acknowledging that he is on GLP-1 medication, which is prescribed both for diabetes treatment and weight loss. The governor told CBS News he started taking the medication after doctors warned that he would likely need insulin for the rest of his life. Pritzker is viewed as a likely 2028 presidential candidate and has spent two years batting away questions about his visibly slimmer appearance, though he did hint at his weight loss during the Gridiron Club and Foundation’s annual white-tie dinner in Washington, D.C., earlier this year. “I’m JB Pritzker, governor of the great state of Illinois, and if you’re seeing me in person for the very first time, yes, I’m the guy who put ‘gov’ in ‘Wegovy,’” he told the high-profile crowd . The 61-year-old governor said he has struggled with his weight since childhood, dating back to when he was a 7-year-old. That’s about the time his father, Donald Pritzker, suffered a fatal heart attack at age 39 while playing tennis. President Donald Trump has made Pritzker’s weight an issue, often commenting about it in personal attacks. Asked about his weight loss during an interview with POLITICO in the spring of 2025, Pritzker said, “How about, just for health.” In Monday’s CBS interview, the governor said he closely monitored his cholesterol, triglycerides and other health markers for years because of his family history. But after becoming governor, he acknowledged the stress of leading the nation’s sixth-largest state contributed to additional weight gain. Two years ago, that concern became more urgent when doctors diagnosed him with Type 2 diabetes, he told CBS. “My doctor said, ‘Oh no, you’ll never come off of it. You’re going to have to do this the rest of your life, and I recommend that you take a GLP-1,’” Pritzker recalled about being told he’d have to take insulin. His wife, MK Pritzker, encouraged her husband to proceed on GLP-1. “I want him to be around for a really long time,” she told CBS. The governor’s office confirmed that as a result of the GLP-1, plus improved diet and exercise, Pritzker “is no longer on insulin and down to levels that indicate no diabetes/prediabetic levels." Pritzker said the effects were almost immediate. Within days, he said, he didn’t feel the appetite urges. “It was the strangest feeling.” The governor also has gained local attention for taking walks along the Lake Michigan walking path in Chicago. Along with adopting the healthy habit, it’s allowed him to talk regularly to constituents. During Monday’s interview, Pritzker side-stepped questions about whether he was running for president. “I honestly am focused on what's best for the people of Illinois,” he said. The governor also talked about being proud of Illinois' decision to cover GLP-1 medications for people with diabetes, becoming emotional describing a woman who approached him and told him access to the medication had saved her life. The announcement about his weight comes as Pritzker is taking a more prominent role in the 2026 midterms, chairing a political action committee focused on investing at least $20 million in Democratic House races. The move has added to speculation about a potential presidential bid, where the demands of a national campaign would put his health and stamina in sharper focus.
articles.headline: Pritzker says he’s lost 80 pounds on GLP-1 since diabetes diagnosis

articles.body: Voters are perfectly fine supporting candidates who aren’t white men. But they do show small preferences for candidates who are younger and Christian, according to new results from The POLITICO Poll . And voters were most likely to penalize transgender candidates in hypothetical matchups, though Democrats were more likely to support them than GOP voters were. The results cast a new light on a simmering, yearslong public conversation within both parties about what it means to be electable and whether putting forward candidates of varying backgrounds is too politically risky in a close election environment. It’s a debate that defined the last open Democratic presidential primary in 2020 and is poised to play a role in 2028 too. Democrats have largely focused their debates on whether voters would accept a person of color or a woman, particularly after President Donald Trump defeated Hillary Clinton in 2016 and Kamala Harris in 2024 — while losing to Joe Biden in 2020. But the poll results suggest the characteristics voters care most about are different, shaped by frustrations over aging politicians and both new and old culture wars. “The American people, I believe, think about identity way less than the average political consultant does,” said Mike Nellis, a longtime Democratic digital strategist who advised Harris’ 2020 presidential campaign. “Obviously there are factors in society that make it harder for women and people of color to get elected, but there are plenty of incredibly talented people out there who are capable of getting over the hump on that.” To test whether demographic characteristics make a candidate more or less electable, POLITICO’s polling partner, Public First, showed thousands of respondents a series of head-to-head matchups. In each case, respondents were given basic information about the candidate’s demographics, such as their race, age and gender; their career, with titles such as doctor, attorney general or CEO; and a single-sentence description of their political alignment, either as a progressive or moderate Democratic, independent, or moderate or MAGA Republican. Respondents then picked which candidate they would prefer, and the results overwhelmingly showed voters cared the most about a candidate’s political ideology. But respondents also revealed more subtle patterns in their preferences. Voters across both parties were more likely to reject older candidates in favor of younger ones. Republicans in particular favored candidates who were described as Christian or regular churchgoers, even when controlling for the candidates’ politics. GOP respondents picked candidates described as regularly attending a church just under 9% more often than candidates who did not have any faith. That means that even though Republican respondents usually picked the GOP candidate in head-to-head matchups, for example, they were more likely to cross over and support an independent or Democratic candidate when that candidate was described as Christian. The results on sexual orientation were more complicated: When candidates were described as “gay,” they were picked about 10% less often across all voters. But when the candidate descriptions describe the candidate as a man married to his husband — without a label for sexual orientation — respondents did not pick them less often in a statistically significant manner. Voters were less likely to pick transgender candidates, with Democratic voters about 5% less likely while GOP voters were 17% less likely, all else held equal. The age results were a strong signal that voters want a new generation of candidates after the last presidential cycle was driven by concerns about Biden’s age, fueling a slew of intergenerational primary contests this year and leading major Democratic voices to publicly call for a younger candidate for 2028. Trump is now 80, and Republicans have faced their own conversations about aging politicians, as Sen. Mitch McConnell (R-Ky.) faced serious health challenges earlier this year. Amanda Litman, co-founder of Run For Something, which recruits candidates under the age of 40, said when the group started its work nearly a decade ago, younger people were often seen as “risky bets” electorally. “Now I think people are starting to see that that is not true. Voters will judge people one by one,” Litman said. “They're also really hungry for change and really hungry for someone who didn't get us into this mess.” The poll found candidates over the age of 70 were nearly 10% less likely to be picked than candidates under the age of 50, with Democrats slightly more likely than Republicans to disfavor a candidate due to age. Notably, The POLITICO Poll didn't find differences based on a candidate’s race or gender overall, outside of gender identity. That has long been a topic of debate among Democrats thinking about winning the presidency. When Harris replaced Biden on the top of Democrats’ ticket in 2024, few questioned that she would choose a white man as her running mate. Since her loss, some Democrats have argued that a white male candidate might be the best path forward for the party in 2028. Harris also wrote in her memoir about the campaign that she thought picking former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg as her running mate would have been “too risky” because he is gay, and that he otherwise would have been her ideal partner. But Buttigieg, who is contemplating running for president in 2028, recently argued that the country is ready for a gay president, saying he wouldn’t have launched a bid in 2020 otherwise. “What's on people's minds isn't about you, your identity as a candidate,” he told NBC News last weekend. “It's about them. It’s about their lives.”
articles.headline: Everyone’s talking about ‘electability.’ Our poll shows where voters stand.

articles.body: <p>“Gran ataque 23 de septiembre” es el nombre de uno de los grupos de mensajería que los servicios de información e inteligencia están monitorizando esta semana, ante la amenaza de una nueva entrada masiva de inmigrantes en Ceuta y también en Melilla, coincidiendo con las elecciones en Marruecos este miércoles. <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/las-fuerzas-de-seguridad-de-marruecos-blindan-la-frontera-con-ceuta-en-visperas-de-las-elecciones.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/las-fuerzas-de-seguridad-de-marruecos-blindan-la-frontera-con-ceuta-en-visperas-de-las-elecciones.html">Rabat ha blindado la frontera,</a> por lo que distintas fuentes policiales dudan de que un episodio como el del 30 y 31 de julio, en el que unas 75.000 personas atravesaron El Tarajal, pueda volver a producirse. Pero movimientos de subsaharianos hacia el norte de África en los últimos días, que confirman fuentes de inteligencia, han alimentado la preocupación. La boya colocada por el Ministerio del Interior en el espigón para ejercer de barrera física pretende sortear los problemas judiciales de las devoluciones en caliente, pero distintas voces policiales reconocen que el control de la frontera depende esencialmente del reino alauí. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/movimientos-de-subsaharianos-hacia-marruecos-alimentan-la-alerta-por-un-nuevo-salto-masivo-en-ceuta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>El presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, ha apuntado esta vez con mucha claridad a la responsabilidad de Marruecos en el fallo del control de la frontera con la ciudad de Ceuta el pasado 30 y 31 de julio y a la necesidad de corregirla. Sánchez ha asegurado que España ha pedido a Rabat medidas urgentes para resolver este problema. Las declaraciones las ha hecho en Nueva York, en una entrevista con la CNN. Preguntado por la crisis de Ceuta, que la periodista Christiane Amanpour ha calificado de “desastre”, ha reivindicado la buena relación con Rabat pero también ha dicho que España ha “pedido respuestas y acciones a Marruecos porque es evidente que su control de la frontera falló”. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/sanchez-pide-explicaciones-a-marruecos-porque-su-control-de-fronteras-fallo.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <p>La diputada del PP Ana Vázquez ha abandonado <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/congreso-diputados/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/congreso-diputados/">el pleno del Congreso de los Diputados</a> entre los aplausos de la mayoría de la bancada popular tras dos llamadas al orden de la presidenta de la Cámara baja, Francina Armengol, que ha obligado a la parlamentaria a depositar fuera del hemiciclo un bote de gas pimienta que ha mostrado durante la sesión de control. “Esto no puede plantearse en la casa de la soberanía del pueblo y en la casa de la democracia”, ha expresado Armengol entre las protestas de Vázquez. La diputada popular ha mostrado el spray en el momento en que formulaba una pregunta al ministro del Interior, Fernando Grande-Marlaska: “Esto es el símbolo de la falta de libertades que sufren las mujeres ceutíes. Este es el material escolar básico, señor Marlaska, un spray de gas pimienta; señor Marlaska, ¿es esta la nueva normalidad a la que se tienen que acostumbrar los ceutíes?”, ha cuestionado Vázquez.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/armengol-pide-a-la-diputada-popular-ana-vazquez-que-abandone-la-camara-por-sacar-un-bote-de-gas-pimienta.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

El acuerdo adoptado este martes por el tribunal de garantías es una zancada casi definitiva que, salvo que haya un giro de guion de última hora, sitúa el regreso del expresidente de la Generalitat a la vuelta de la esquina. Si el Constitucional, como es previsible, aprueba el próximo 6 de octubre las sentencias favorables a amnistiar a los ex consejeros Jordi Turull y Dolors Bassa, que se votarán ese día, y los argumentos de esas resoluciones son extrapolables al resto de líderes independentistas, la intención del magistrado Pablo Llarena, instructor del <i>procés</i>, es levantar de forma inmediata la orden de detención que pesa contra Puigdemont sin esperar a que el Constitucional resuelva el recurso de amparo presentado por el <i>expresident</i>, cuya deliberación todavía no tiene fecha. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/el-supremo-preve-levantar-la-orden-de-detencion-de-puigdemont-cuando-reciba-el-aval-del-constitucional-que-resolvera-el-6-de-octubre.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/J2LHZANLZVEDLNFYHFSGPMBMSM.jpg?auth=16ffdc75646f4f1e2a42bd7fb3c80894b7e9aa22c35d83bfd6c3d65d1bfb7017" width="4657" height="3224" alt="Begoña Gómez, esposa del presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, en su comparecencia en una comisión en la Asamblea de Madrid."></img><p>En septiembre de 2024, tres meses antes de que Begoña Gómez <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2024-12-18/begona-gomez-niega-ante-el-juez-peinado-los-cuatro-delitos-que-se-le-imputan.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2024-12-18/begona-gomez-niega-ante-el-juez-peinado-los-cuatro-delitos-que-se-le-imputan.html">declarara por primera vez ante el magistrado Juan Carlos Peinado</a>, la Oficina del Censo Electoral realizó el sorteo que establecía los posibles miembros de jurados populares para los dos próximos años. Nueve de las más de 3.000 personas que acabaron conformando la lista definitiva juzgarán a la esposa del presidente del Gobierno por malversación y tráfico de influencias, después de que el juez instructor <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/el-juez-peinado-abre-juicio-oral-a-begona-gomez-por-delitos-de-trafico-de-influencias-y-malversacion.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/el-juez-peinado-abre-juicio-oral-a-begona-gomez-por-delitos-de-trafico-de-influencias-y-malversacion.html">decidiese este lunes cerrar de una vez por todas su polémica investigación</a>, siempre y cuando el sorteo específico para este juicio se produzca antes del 31 de diciembre. Si no, los llamados a dictaminar la inocencia o culpabilidad de Gómez y su asistenta en la Moncloa, Cristina Álvarez, saldrán de una lista que empezó a conformarse la semana pasada, con un sorteo general que da comienzo a un largo procedimiento hasta acabar sentado en el tribunal. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-23/sorteos-cribas-y-descartes-arbitrarios-la-seleccion-de-los-nueve-ciudadanos-que-juzgaran-a-begona-gomez.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

Esta vez, Sánchez no viaja a Nueva York con su esposa, pero en otras ocasiones sí estaba con ella en esos viajes marcados por las decisiones de Peinado y el impacto fue aún más fuerte. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/sanchez-se-entero-en-el-avion-a-nueva-york-de-la-apertura-de-juicio-a-begona-gomez-los-grandes-hitos-del-caso-han-coincidido-con-viajes-del-presidente.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: <img src="https://imagenes.elpais.com/resizer/v2/J2LHZANLZVEDLNFYHFSGPMBMSM.jpg?auth=16ffdc75646f4f1e2a42bd7fb3c80894b7e9aa22c35d83bfd6c3d65d1bfb7017" width="4657" height="3224" alt="Begoña Gómez, en una comisión de investigación de la Asamblea de Madrid, en noviembre de 2024."></img><p>El magistrado Juan Carlos Peinado ha dirigido durante dos años y cinco meses una investigación cargada de polémica contra Begoña Gómez, esposa del presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez. Por primera vez en la historia democrática de España, un juez instructor ha imputado, ha procesado y ha enviado al banquillo (<a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/el-juez-peinado-abre-juicio-oral-a-begona-gomez-por-delitos-de-trafico-de-influencias-y-malversacion.html" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-21/el-juez-peinado-abre-juicio-oral-a-begona-gomez-por-delitos-de-trafico-de-influencias-y-malversacion.html">decisión que firmó este mismo lunes</a>, apenas seis días antes de jubilarse) a la pareja de un jefe del Ejecutivo. Aunque la Audiencia Provincial de Madrid ha encauzado parte de sus pesquisas y ha marcado la senda por donde el sumario podía prosperar, Peinado ha encabezado la iniciativa para que se siente a Gómez ante un jurado popular formado por nueve ciudadanos. Pero, a partir de ahora, queda ya todo lejos de las manos del cuestionado magistrado. Comienza, en palabras de fuentes cercanas al caso, la “era pos-Peinado”. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/el-caso-begona-gomez-entra-en-la-era-pos-peinado-que-plazos-se-manejan-para-el-juicio-testificara-pedro-sanchez.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>
articles.headline: El ‘caso Begoña Gómez’ entra en la era pos-Peinado: ¿qué plazos se manejan para el juicio?, ¿testificará Pedro Sánchez?

articles.body: <p>La enorme distancia política entre Pedro Sánchez y Donald Trump, jalonada con varios choques directos y muy duros, tendrá un nuevo hito hoy con la ausencia del presidente del Gobierno español en la tradicional recepción que ofrece el líder de EEUU en Nueva York en el contexto de la Asamblea General de la ONU. <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/pedro-sanchez-perez-castejon/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/pedro-sanchez-perez-castejon/">Sánchez</a>, pese a estar invitado, no acudirá este martes a la recepción “por motivos de agenda”, según la versión del Gobierno. El Ejecutivo alega que por la tarde, entre 17.00 y 20.00, Sánchez tiene previstas citas con el gobernador de California, el demócrata Gavin Newsom, el ex primer ministro de la Mancomunidad de Australia y con el presidente ejecutivo de Apple. Tim Cook. Después, señalan, irá al hotel a preparar su discurso en la Asamblea General, previsto para el miércoles. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/sanchez-no-asistira-a-la-recepcion-que-ofrece-trump-por-la-asamblea-de-la-onu.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

"></img><p>Desde antes del verano <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-30/carmen-calvo-presidenta-del-consejo-de-estado-el-sueldo-de-expresidente-tendria-que-ser-suficiente-porque-el-honor-del-cargo-es-inmaterial.html" target="_blank" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-30/carmen-calvo-presidenta-del-consejo-de-estado-el-sueldo-de-expresidente-tendria-que-ser-suficiente-porque-el-honor-del-cargo-es-inmaterial.html">la presidenta del Consejo de Estado, Carmen Calvo,</a> había manifestado en las reuniones de sus órganos, la necesidad de “tomar decisiones” antes de que empezara el otoño. La larga inasistencia de dos miembros permanentes del consejo, María Teresa Fernández de la Vega y de José Luis Manzanares, responsables de sendas secciones, hace recaer en el resto de los consejeros natos, 9 en total, sus tareas. Con solo 7 de 9 no se pueden funcionar adecuadamente, señalan fuentes funcionariales, en línea con lo que manifiesta la presidenta del <a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-30/el-consejo-de-estado-celebra-su-500-aniversario-con-la-misma-meta-merecer-la-confianza-de-los-ciudadanos.html" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-05-30/el-consejo-de-estado-celebra-su-500-aniversario-con-la-misma-meta-merecer-la-confianza-de-los-ciudadanos.html">Consejo </a>a EL PAÍS: “En varias ocasiones he manifestado tanto en la comisión permanente como en el plenario, que los intereses de este órgano constitucional, al que se le debe exigir la máxima excelencia y rigor, están por encima de todos y cada uno de nosotros, los consejeros”.</p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/2026-09-22/carmen-calvo-inicia-el-proceso-para-incapacitar-a-fernandez-de-la-vega-y-jose-luis-manzanares-como-miembros-del-consejo-de-estado.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

articles.body: Vols veure  gegants per la Mercè 2026 ? Els balls de gegants són una de les activitats tradicionals de les  Festes de la Mercè 2026  més esperades per petits i grans. Al llarg de la festa major, tindràs fins a  una desena d’oportunitats   per gaudir de les actuacions geganteres , des del  Toc d’inici   fins al Toc a plegar, que posarà punt final a les festes. El recorregut serà el següent: la Rambla carrer de Ferran plaça de Sant Jaume Una hora després, a les 20 h, un cop fet el pregó, hi haurà el  Toc d’inici  amb el  Seguici popular  de Barcelona acompanyat del Rolling Latern Show, i els  Ministrils del Camí Ral , que només toquen un cop l’any! Serà a la  plaça de Sant Jaume . Els gegants sortiran de la plaça de Sant Jaume, a les 22 h i recorreran diversos carrers com: Ciutat, Regomir, Ample, Simó Oller i Mercè , per tornar després pel mateix camí i arribar, de nou, a Sant Jaume. Cavalcada de la Mercè (dijous 24 de setembre ) A la tarda, nova cita amb els gegants, ara en moviment. És un dels grans moments de la festa major, amb totes les colles geganteres de la ciutat. 18 h: inici de la  cavalcada  de la Mercè amb el Rolling Lantern Show. Plaça de Catalunya, Fontanella, via Laietana i Jaume I. Finalment, la desfilada  arribarà a la plaça de Sant Jaume  i les colles entraran a l’Ajuntament de Barcelona amb els balls dels Capgrossos Macers, de l’Àliga i dels Gegants de la Ciutat. articles.body: La tradició marca que el dia abans de la Mercè, just després del pregó , el Toc d’inici marca totes les activitats de la Festa Major de Barcelona . Aquest ball de gegants i bèsties és el ritual inaugural de les festes de Barcelona i se celebra des de l’any 1993. Aquí, tot el que n’has de saber. >> Mercè 2026: guia completa Quan i on? El Toc d’inici es fa el dimecres 23 de setembre a la plaça de Sant Jaume a les 20 h (si no podeu anar a viure’l en primera persona, el podreu seguir en directe a betevé , en un programa especial que coincidirà amb el tret de sortida les festes!) Què hi veureu Cada any la plaça s’omple de gom a gom per rebre el Seguici inaugural de Barcelona , format per l’Àliga de la Ciutat, el Lleó, la Mulassa, el Bou, la Víbria, el Drac, la Tarasca, els Gegants del Pi, els Gegants de la Ciutat, els Capgrossos Macers, els Cavallets Cotoners, els Gegants de Santa Maria del Mar, els Falcons de Barcelona i el Ball de Bastons, que surten a les 19 h del Palau de la Virreina per recórrer carrers i donar la benvinguda a la festa fins a arribar a la plaça de Sant Jaume. Un cop a plaça, cap a les 20 h el Seguici mostra els seus balls. Ho fa al so dels  Ministrils del Camí Ral , una gran formació de 40 músics amb instruments tradicionals que es reuneix exclusivament per aquest esdeveniment, que s’ha convertit en una cita ineludible. Si us agrada la festa, no us podeu perdre un dels concerts gratuïts més esperats del programa, que reunirà tres noms destacats de l’escena catalana: Love of Lesbian, La Pegatina i Svetlana . El grup d’indie rock i indie pop va anunciar a principis d’any que farà una “pausa indefinida” després de 25 anys de trajectòria d’èxit, i el concert gratuït al Bogatell és una bona oportunitat per gaudir d’un dels directes més vibrants de l’escena espanyola, en què repassarà els temes del darrer disc, Ejercito de salvación , però on segur que sonaran altres temes, alguns dels quans són veritables himnes per als seus fans. Tot, a ritme d’electropop queer amb què aquest duet aconsegueix agitar consciències posant la lupa en qüestions com la gentrificació o la precarietat, alhora que fa moure l’esquelet. articles.body: El pressupost municipal del 2026 preveu una inversió de 50 M€ ( fruit d’un pacte amb ERC ) per accelerar la rehabilitació de pisos a la ciutat. L’alcalde Jaume Collboni vol repetir la fórmula als propers comptes i tornarà a incorporar una partida per a la reforma d’habitatges. En una entrevista a El Periódico , Collboni ha anunciat que hi dedicarà 35 M€ addicionals , amb els quals pretén donar un impuls fort a la rehabilitació. “El nostre objectiu és triplicar el nombre de pisos en rehabilitació a partir del 2027 , la mitjana han estat 1.000 anuals i passarem a 3.000 amb un nou pla anomenat Rehabilita B “, ha explicat l’alcalde. La intenció de l’executiu socialista és compartir el finançament de la reforma d’aquests pisos, per exemple, amb la Generalitat. De fet, els dos governs col·laboraran en la regeneració del Besòs i el Maresme . articles.body: La Sindicatura de Greuges de Barcelona demana a TMB que actuï de forma immediata “per recuperar les condicions d’accessibilitat i confort” de la parada d’autobús 1257 de la plaça de Catalunya, on presten servei la Línia D50 i els autobusos nocturns N5, N6 i N7 . A principis d’estiu aquesta parada va canviar d’ubicació i es va situar uns metres més enllà però sense mantenir la marquesina que tenia. En canvi, el bus turístic , amb qui compartia parada, s’ha mantingut al mateix punt on era. El resultat, els usuaris de la línia D50 han d’esperar l’autobús a ple sol mentre que els turistes ho fa a l’ombra , sota la marquesina. També et pot interessar La Sindicatura de Greuges demana més control dels espectacles no autoritzats al centre de Barcelona Marta Casals Torres 1 minut de lectura Una parada sense seients ni protecció climàtica El síndic ha emès una resolució, arran de la queixa presentada per l’Associació de Veïns de l’Eixample , en què insta al consistori a “recuperar al més aviat possible una marquesina i torni a oferir les mateixes condicions que tenia abans del seu trasllat”. La sindicatura denuncia que la parada actual “només disposa d’un pal informatiu i no hi ha ni amb seients ni amb elements de protecció climàtica “, fet que afecta especialment col·lectius vulnerables com les persones grans o amb discapacitat. També demana reforçar la vigilància per evitar que davant de la parada hi estacionin motocicletes i hi hagi elements que en “dificultin la funcionalitat”.  La Sindicatura reclama a TMB que garanteixi plenament “el dret a la mobilitat de la ciutadania” i incideix en la necessitat de “protegir les persones usuàries dels efectes de la calor”. articles.body: La majoria de nosaltres, quan sentim la paraula hamburguesa , ràpidament la relacionem amb l’entrepà nacional dels Estats Units o, fins i tot, amb els immigrants alemanys que la van introduir sota el nom de filet d’Hamburg . Ara, però, la gastronomia xinesa , amb plats encara molt desconeguts pel gran públic, demana la seva quota de protagonisme. El roujiamo (literalment, ‘carn farcida dins d’un pa’) té més de 2.000 anys d’història, i el restaurant Mómo , al carrer de Cartagena, 210 , capitanejat per la Song Jie i en Wang Zening , en fa bandera. Un dels menús disponibles al Mómo pibe El Pibe, precursor de portar el menjar ràpid a Barcelona: 52 anys cuinant frànkfurts a la barra Aitana Molina 4 minuts de lectura 2.200 anys d’història Molt abans que el concepte d’hamburguesa es popularitzés a Occident, a la província xinesa de Shaanxi i, més en concret, a la seva capital, Xi’an (mundialment famosa pels seus soldats de terracota), ja es consumia el roujiamo . Aquest entrepà de carn picada acumula segles de tradició culinària. La preparació del pa ( mo ) data de la dinastia Qin (221-206 aC), mentre que la tècnica per guisar la carn ( lazhi ) es remunta a la dinastia Zhou (1045-256 aC). Per aquesta raó, alguns la consideren l’hamburguesa primigènia. La Song va més enllà: “La Xina estava condicionada per factors geogràfics, econòmics i socials que limitaven l’intercanvi amb el món. Per aquest motiu, molts aliments xinesos no van tenir la mateixa oportunitat que les hamburgueses, els entrepans o els tacos d’entrar en el circuit gastronòmic internacional”. En certa manera, Mómo vol ser ambaixador del menjar tradicional xinès a la ciutat. L’entrepà rodó i cruixent farcit de carn picada, una recepta amb 2.000 anys d’història Ni bao ni pa de brioix: com es prepara el mo ? Si ens parlen d’entrepans xinesos, a molts de nosaltres el primer que ens ve al cap és el bao . A diferència d’aquests pans al vapor, el pa del roujiamo té una textura i una elaboració ben diferents. En Wang , el xef del Mómo , ens explica que cada matí preparen aquests panets rodons fets amb farina de blat, però que tenen una consistència semblant a la d’una pasta fullada . El mo , el pa rodó del rouijamo Estiren la massa amb l’ajuda d’una màquina pastadora i la repleguen sobre si mateixa per, finalment, donar-li la forma arrodonida. El mo es cou tradicionalment en forns d’argila o es daura directament a la paella; en Wang els escalfa en una planxa uns sis minuts i després els enforna per aconseguir una crosta exterior molt cruixent i un interior tou i eixut que permet absorbir els sucs de la carn, cosa que dona com a resultat un entrepà molt més sucós . Els pans del Mómo s’acaben al forn El farcit tradicional s’elabora amb carn, normalment cap de porc, que en el cas del Mómo ens asseguren que ve de Girona. La carn queda estofada durant set hores en un brou amb més de 10 espècies i condiments, entre els quals destaquen l’anís estrellat , el fonoll , o el pebre negre i blanc . Un cop cuita, la carn es pica ben fina amb el ganivet, es farceix al pa i s’hi afegeix una mica del mateix brou reduït per garantir la màxima melositat. El resultat final és el d’un mos saborós, amb una carn de gust molt fi que es fon a la boca. La recepta tradicional del roujiamo amb cap de llom i un brou amb 10 espècies Quan orient i occident es troben a l’Eixample A banda de l’hamburguesa tradicional de carn de porc, al Mómo han volgut fer una picada d’ullet al públic occidental i tenen a la seva carta una smash burger al més pur estil nord-americà. Tot es conserva: doble de carn, ceba confitada, cogombrets, salsa especial d’hamburguesa i un bon formatge cheddar; però el toc xinès ens arriba amb el mo . La smash burguer del Mómo Pel fet de tractar-se d’un pa especialment lleuger i cruixent , no emmascara el gust de la carn, com a vegades pot passar amb alguns brioixos tradicionals d’hamburguesa amb massa gust de mantega . El punt cruixent acompanya, i la facilitat que té aquest panet xinès per retenir la salsa fa que l’entrepà quedi especialment saborós . La Song ens torna a interpel·lar sobre aquest punt de trobada gastronòmic: “El que volem fer és crear un veritable diàleg entre cultures: prendre la tradició xinesa com a punt de partida, Barcelona com a font d’inspiració i, des del respecte pel producte local, crear noves propostes a Mómo”. A Mómo trobareu un local modern , amb tons vermellosos, molt a l’estil de les hamburgueseries que s’han fet omnipresents al nostre panorama gastronòmic barceloní. La Song i el Wang, a més, us donaran una càlida benvinguda que, en el món de la restauració actual, també s’agraeix.

articles.body: El vi català tindrà una forta presència al pregó de la Mercè 2026 , ja que aquest any se n’ha fet l’encàrrec a dos grans experts: els propietaris de l’històric Celler de Gelida de Sants, Toni Falgueras i la seva filla, la sommelier Meritxell Falgueras . En un pregó a quatre mans, els Falgueras brindaran per donar inici a la Festa Major de Barcelona, amb un discurs que, avancen, volen que “es paladegi, es vegi i s’assaboreixi”. El Celler de Gelida té més de 130 anys d’història al número 65 del carrer de Vallespir, i com a botiguers, pare i filla també volen reivindicar el paper de les botigues de proximitat , “on la fent es mira als ulls”, just l’any que Barcelona ha estat nomenada Capital Europea del Comerç Local per la Unió Europea. El pregó es fa aquest dimecres, 23 de setembre , al Saló de Cent de l’Ajuntament de Barcelona i es podrà seguir en directe a betevé, de 18.30 a 20 h. També et pot interessar La Mercè 2026 a Barcelona: Programa en PDF, concerts, Piromusical i portes obertes de la festa major Neus Valls Núria Dias Sílvia Carbonell 9 minuts de lectura Toni Falgueras, tota una vida envoltat de vi Veí de Sants, Antoni Falgueras va néixer al carrer de Vallespir. Botiguer i apassionat pel vi, és la quarta generació al capdavant del negoci que avui dispensa vins i escumosos d’arreu del món, d’ençà que el seu besavi va obrir la botiga l’any 1895 a Gelida, en què servia vins a granel, olis, gels i sabons. Més endavant, va ser la besàvia i el seu fill —pare d’Antoni Falgueras— els qui van aixecar la persiana del comerç al barri de Sants. Antoni Falgueras ha rebut la Medalla del Mèrit Agrícola de França (2008) i el premi Aliments d’Espanya—concedit pel Ministeri d’Agricultura. És membre fundador de Mestres Cellerers de Catalunya i de l’Associació Catalana de Sommeliers, també n’és de l’Acadèmia de Tastavins de Sant Humbert i de totes les confraries catalanes, així com confrare d’honor de la Confraria del Cava. I, per últim, és membre de les confraries franceses Clos Vougeot, Armagnac, Champagne i Catalunya Nord. També et pot interessar Antoni Falgueras: “Jo encara espero descobrir el vi més bo” Cristina Brotons 5 minuts de lectura Meritxell Falgueras, la divulgació de la cultura del vi La sommelier i periodista Meritxell Falgueras comparteix amb el seu pare la passió pel vi i ha buscat compartir els seus coneixements amb un llenguatge proper i divertit. Amb només 20 anys es va convertir en la sommelier més jove d’Espanya . També és autora de diversos llibres, l’últim Mujeres del vino , publicat el 2025. Ella i el seu germà Ferran porten ara les regnes del negoci familiar, de d’on segueixen assessorant milers de clients per maridar amb el millor vi cada àpat o esdeveniment. Avui, tenen més de 5.000 referències a la botiga , entre els quals els vins catalans que coneixen i tracten amb cura, i que fan brillar al costat de grans vins d’arreu del món. També et pot interessar Meritxell Falgueras: “Sants és el nou Soho” Bàsics 1 minut de lectura I després del pregó… el Toc d’inici Una vegada finalitzat el pregó, arribarà el torn del Toc d’inici de la Mercè a la plaça de Sant Jaume. El ball, al voltant de les 20 h , és el ritual d’inici de les festes que protagonitzen cada any els gegants i el bestiari de la ciutat. Els Gegants de la Ciutat, del Pi i de Santa Maria del Mar encapçalen la comitiva, en la qual també hi ha l’ Àliga, el Lleó, la Mulassa, la Víbria i el Drac , els trabucaires i els diables, entre d’altres.
